# The Fifth Kind

> The Fifth Kind (the5thkind.in) is an AI studio in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India, that builds AI automation for businesses — custom AI chatbots, WhatsApp chatbots, AI voice agents and AI agents that automate quotations, invoices and follow-ups — and produces story-first AI video content. Founded by Uday Khandelwal. Not affiliated with the5thkind.com (a Paul Wallis podcast on ancient mysteries).

Website: https://www.the5thkind.in/
Contact: uday.khandelwal@the5thkind.in · +91 82960 08838 (phone & WhatsApp) · Instagram @the5thkind.ai
Address: 529, 8th Cross, Nanjappa Rd, Shantinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560027, India
Serves: businesses across India and internationally — SMEs, manufacturers, distributors, D2C brands, startups, personal brands.
Selected clients: Arvind Mills, Schüco, JITO Bangalore, Mahaveer Papers, Hybec Deco, Hybec Air.

## Automate — AI for customer engagement and operations

- [Custom AI Chatbot](https://www.the5thkind.in/ai-chatbot-development/): chatbots trained on a business's own product catalogue, specs, prices and FAQs; answer on the website and WhatsApp 24/7 in English, Hindi or Hinglish, qualify leads and send them to the team. Live example: the chatbot on mahaveerpapers.com.
- [WhatsApp Chatbot & Automation](https://www.the5thkind.in/whatsapp-chatbot/): AI WhatsApp chatbots on the official WhatsApp Business API — instant replies, lead qualification, quotes, payment links, order updates, broadcasts, human handover.
- [AI Voice Agent](https://www.the5thkind.in/ai-voice-agent/): AI voice/calling agents that answer and make phone calls in Hindi, Hinglish and English — lead callbacks, dealer offer calls, COD confirmation, reminders, AI receptionist.
- [AI Agents & Business Automation](https://www.the5thkind.in/ai-automation-agency/): AI agents that automate quotations, invoices, billing, payment reminders, lead follow-ups, order updates and daily reports, connected to WhatsApp, Google Sheets, Excel, Tally, Zoho and CRMs. Free automation consult.

## Create — AI video production

- [AI Video Production in Bangalore](https://www.the5thkind.in/ai-video-production-bangalore/): overview of the studio's AI video services.
- [AI Product Video](https://www.the5thkind.in/ai-product-video/): 15–45 second AI product videos for launches and ads.
- [AI Clone Video](https://www.the5thkind.in/ai-clone-video/): consent-based digital twin videos for founders, doctors and coaches.
- [AI Character & Story Video](https://www.the5thkind.in/ai-character-story-video/): cinematic brand stories with original AI characters.
- [Brand & Ad Film](https://www.the5thkind.in/ai-ad-film/): 1–3 minute AI ad films — script, direction, sound, colour.
- [Reel Editing](https://www.the5thkind.in/reel-editing-services/): editing existing footage into retention-focused reels.
